✨ Case Study · Lifter Gel India Launch · 2026
Fall Into The Gel Spell — Building India's Gloss Category

"Main Character Lips" — category creation, Gen-Z virality & collectible culture 💋

Led the full India 360° launch of Maybelline Lifter Gel — a first-of-its-kind oil-in-gel formula. Brief: establish superiority in an underdeveloped gloss category, build cultural relevance with Gen-Z, and hack virality before a single ad ran.

🎯 3 Campaign Priorities

Glass Lip Hypnosis · Collectible Craze · Dopamine Edu-tainment

🧲
Glass Lip Hypnosis: IT-girl positioning — glossy shine + oil care. "Twist. Click. Shine." as a ritualistic content trigger. ASMR-forward formats to drive sensory obsession.
🎁
Collectible Craze: PR Spellbook kit for creators. Sellable Lifter Gel Duo Kit at launch. Friendship Day collectible charm stations.
🎬
Dopamine Edu-tainment: 3,000 creator content stitching program + "The Lifter Gel-evator" micro-series — 4 episodes with top Gen-Z creators.

🍫 Case Study · Cadbury Silk × Maybelline · Blinkit · V-Day 2025
Quick Commerce Gifting — Data-Led Category Crossover

Beauty meets chocolate — reaching the gifter, not just the makeup buyer 💜

Google Trends showed chocolate searches peak on Chocolate Day (Feb 7–9). Cadbury held the highest SOV in gifting. Built 5 exclusive Silk × Maybelline bundles on Blinkit — the only beauty brand on first scroll for Teddy Day, Kiss Day & Chocolate Day. Co-marketed across beauty and confectionery. Sold out during Valentine's week · 1.6x offtake vs BAU · 60% contribution to Feb offtakes.

💋 Campaign · Superstay Matte Ink · Desi Girl Approved
Global Claim → Local Cultural Truth

"A lipstick that survives the real Desi Girl test" 🇮🇳

Superstay's global claim — Resists 1000 Touches — was powerful but generic. The India insight reframed it: a Desi girl's day isn't just about looking good, it's about lasting through spicy food, monsoon downpours, rickshaw rides and heat. That's the real test. Translated into:

🎯
"Desi Girl Approved" stamp — positioned Matte Ink as the ultimate longwear for the Indian woman's actual life, not a sanitised global version of it
📹
Desi Girl Torture Tests — creators documented real surviving moments (rush hour, spicy snacks, surprise monsoon) driving high authentic engagement
🎞
Terribly Tiny Tales micro-series — co-created with India's OG storytelling collective (3.4M followers) to gamify nostalgia & recruit Gen-Z · 620K+ views · 2M impressions · #1 shade on platform
Desi Girl Torture Test — Advocacy Reel Watch → Desi Girl Approved — Campaign Post Watch → Desi Girl on the Go — Creator Reel Watch → 🎬 Terribly Tiny Tales Micro-Series Watch →

Cadbury + Desi Girl Approved 💋
